notice: Curated offline seed database. Version ranges are approximate and must be verified against vendor advisories. Online NVD/EPSS enrichment is used for broader coverage.

records.title: Apache Log4j2 JNDI lookup remote code execution (Log4Shell)
records.description: Log4j2 versions before 2.15.0 evaluate JNDI lookups in attacker-controlled log messages, allowing remote code execution in many configurations.
records.remediation: Upgrade Log4j2 to 2.17.1 or later (2.15.0/2.16.0 are interim fixes). Remove JndiLookup from affected archives as an emergency mitigation and review logging data flows.

records.title: Spring Framework data binding remote code execution (Spring4Shell)
records.description: Spring MVC/WebFlux applications on JDK 9+ may be vulnerable to data-binding manipulation when deployed as a WAR on Tomcat. Exploitability is configuration-dependent.
records.remediation: Upgrade Spring Framework to 5.3.18+ / 5.2.20+ or a supported branch. Where upgrade is not possible, apply the vendor workaround (disallowed fields or custom DataBinder) and restrict server access.

records.title: Apache HTTP Server path traversal and file disclosure
records.description: A path normalization flaw in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 can allow traversal outside configured document roots. With mod_cgi enabled this can lead to command execution; otherwise it is a file disclosure issue.
records.remediation: Upgrade to Apache HTTP Server 2.4.51 or later. Review Require/Alias configuration and disable unnecessary CGI handlers.

records.title: Apache HTTP Server path traversal and possible remote code execution
records.description: The incomplete fix for CVE-2021-41773 in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.50 remains bypassable, enabling path traversal and, in CGI-enabled configurations, remote code execution.
records.remediation: Upgrade to Apache HTTP Server 2.4.51 or later immediately. Remove mod_cgi/mod_cgid where unnecessary.

records.title: Apache Tomcat AJP file inclusion (Ghostcat)
records.description: The AJP connector in affected Tomcat versions allows an attacker to read files under the web application root and potentially execute code if uploads are permitted. Exposure requires the AJP port to be reachable.
records.remediation: Upgrade to Tomcat 7.0.100, 8.5.51, 9.0.31 or later. Disable or bind the AJP connector to localhost and require authentication.

records.title: Apache Tomcat JSP upload via HTTP PUT
records.description: Tomcat 7.0.0 through 7.0.79 is vulnerable to remote code execution through HTTP PUT when the DefaultServlet read-only parameter is disabled, allowing JSP upload.
records.remediation: Upgrade to Tomcat 7.0.81+ and keep DefaultServlet read-only=true. Remove write access for web content directories.

records.title: OpenSSH unauthenticated signal handler race (regreSSHion)
records.description: OpenSSH server versions 8.5p1 through 9.7p1 contain a signal-handler race condition that can lead to unauthenticated remote code execution on glibc-based Linux systems. Exploitation is probabilistic and architecture-dependent.
records.remediation: Upgrade OpenSSH to 9.8p1 or later (vendor backports may exist). Limit SSH exposure and enforce strong authentication.

records.title: OpenSSH ssh-agent PKCS#11 remote code execution
records.description: OpenSSH versions before 9.3p2 allow remote code execution in ssh-agent under specific PKCS#11 forwarding conditions. Client-side exploitation requires attacker-controlled keys or agent forwarding.
records.remediation: Upgrade to OpenSSH 9.3p2 or later and avoid agent forwarding to untrusted hosts.

records.title: vsftpd 2.3.4 backdoor command execution
records.description: The distributed vsftpd 2.3.4 source archive contained a backdoor that opens a shell when a username ending in ':)' is supplied. This is a supply-chain compromise, not a configuration issue.
records.remediation: Replace the vsftpd installation with a trusted, current release, rebuild the host from known-good media, and perform a full compromise assessment.

records.title: Grafana plugin path traversal file disclosure
records.description: Grafana 8.0.0 through 8.3.0 is vulnerable to unauthenticated path traversal through plugin asset routes, allowing local file disclosure.
records.remediation: Upgrade Grafana to 8.3.1 or later (ideally a current supported release). Restrict network access to Grafana and rotate any secrets stored in files readable by the service.

records.title: GitLab account takeover via password reset email delivery
records.description: Affected GitLab versions allow an unauthenticated attacker to send password reset emails to an attacker-controlled address, potentially taking over accounts. Version branches have different fixed releases; verify the specific advisory.
records.remediation: Upgrade to a fixed release for your GitLab line (16.7.2, 16.6.4, 16.5.6, 16.4.4, 16.3.6, 16.2.8, 16.1.6, 16.0.8, or 15.11.13). Enable multi-factor authentication.

records.title: Atlassian Confluence improper authorization leading to data loss
records.description: An improper authorization flaw in Confluence Data Center and Server allows an unauthenticated attacker to impact confidentiality, integrity, and availability. Exploitation can result in data loss.
records.remediation: Upgrade Confluence to 7.19.16, 8.3.4, 8.4.4, 8.5.2 or later. Block external access until patched and back up the instance.

records.title: jQuery cross-site scripting in htmlPrefilter
records.description: jQuery versions before 3.5.0 may execute untrusted HTML passed to DOM manipulation methods after htmlPrefilter transforms it, enabling cross-site scripting in affected applications.
records.remediation: Upgrade jQuery to 3.5.0 or later and avoid passing untrusted input to .html(), .append(), or similar DOM sinks.

records.title: Bootstrap cross-site scripting in tooltip and popover data attributes
records.description: Bootstrap tooltip/popover components before 3.4.1/4.3.1 do not sufficiently sanitize data attributes, allowing XSS when attacker-controlled values reach those attributes.
records.remediation: Upgrade Bootstrap to 3.4.1 or 4.3.1+ and sanitize values rendered into data-* attributes.

records.title: Drupal remote code execution (Drupalgeddon2)
records.description: Multiple Drupal subsystems insufficiently sanitize input in affected versions, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution in common configurations.
records.remediation: Upgrade Drupal to 7.58, 8.3.9, 8.4.6, 8.5.1 or later. If upgrading is not immediately possible, apply the vendor patch and review logs for compromise.

records.title: Webmin unauthenticated command execution in password change
records.description: Webmin 1.890 through 1.919 contains a command injection flaw in the password change endpoint when the expired-password feature is enabled, allowing unauthenticated command execution.
records.remediation: Upgrade Webmin to 1.920 or later and disable password expiry if the patch cannot be applied immediately. Restrict port 10000 access.

records.title: Apache Struts 2 Jakarta Multipart parser remote code execution
records.description: The Jakarta Multipart parser in affected Struts 2 versions mishandles Content-Type headers, allowing remote command execution.
records.remediation: Upgrade Struts 2 to 2.3.32/2.5.10.1 or later, or apply the vendor servlet filter mitigation. Treat exposed instances as potentially compromised.

records.title: PHP-FPM underflow leading to remote code execution with Nginx
records.description: A buffer underflow in PHP-FPM can lead to remote code execution when used with certain Nginx configurations that pass unsanitized path info. Exploitability depends on the web server configuration.
records.remediation: Upgrade PHP to 7.1.33, 7.2.24, 7.3.11 or later, and set fastcgi_split_path_info/ PATH_INFO handling per vendor guidance.

records.title: Nginx resolver off-by-one heap write
records.description: An off-by-one error in the Nginx resolver can allow a DNS response from an attacker-controlled DNS server to overwrite one byte of heap memory, potentially leading to worker process compromise.
records.remediation: Upgrade Nginx to 1.20.1 or 1.21.0+; restrict which DNS servers the resolver may query.
